title: 🎀 Blue Ribbon Rebel
content:
Sweet? Maybe. Soft? Never.

This look is all about contradictions — a massive denim bow meets sleek flared pants and satin ribbon details. It’s girly with a side of don’t-mess-with-me. 💅✨

The bow was built using layered internal lines and puff volume, giving it that bold sculptural shape without losing softness. The pants? High-waisted and full of movement, finished with contrast ties to break the structure.

🧷 Made entirely in CLO  
💙 Custom denim texture  
🧶 Ribbon details mapped manually  
🔥 Attitude level: maxed out

I can't upload my work for the contest because it gives an error when uploading ZPRJ file. The number of polygons of clothing does not exceed 40,000 (my clothes 29300). I also uploaded an avatar in A pose without animation as indicated in the guide.   
I think maybe the problem is in the number of polygons in the avatar? Its number is 87K polygons  
I attached a screenshot of error. How can I fix this problem?  
UPD: I try to upload without avatar the same problem  
  
Thank you  
![42c1dfeb111e4e2eb0c8a01f3cfee887](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202507/eac5b4177d0449e4a0b4ce3e8fec16b8/images/42c1dfeb111e4e2eb0c8a01f3cfee887photo_2025-07-16_23-34-26.jpg)

title: 👑 Denim Royalty
content:
There's something magical about turning a traditionally casual fabric into something majestic. With _Denim Royalty_ , I wanted to explore how far denim could go when treated like couture — structured, voluminous, and with a bit of drama.

This look features a corseted upper silhouette that hugs the torso, balanced by two exaggerated puff sleeves that bring immediate visual impact. The sleeves are constructed with layered pattern pieces and volume modifiers to create a soft yet sculptural shape, mimicking the petals of a blooming flower — only in denim.

The lower part flows into a siren skirt with a soft flare and a distressed edge finish. I intentionally kept the seams exposed and slightly frayed to contrast the gown-like structure with a sense of rawness and deconstruction. It’s a clash between elegance and edge — and I love that tension.

Let me know — would you wear couture denim to a gala? Because I definitely would 💙
